name: Baldur's Gate 3
quirks: Luma keeps modsettings.lsx in step with your mods while they're in the game: enabled .pak mods are turned on in your mod order, after the game's own and the in-game mod manager's.
Script Extender mods need BG3SE; Luma installs it when a mod lists it as a requirement.
Mods from the in-game mod.io browser are managed by the game.
